_about: Photo library, all 1080x1920 graded JPGs. 'points' are pixel coordinates for label leaders. 'used_in' lists episodes; prefer photos used least recently. Add every new photo here.

hero.desc: Aerial drone shot, white ~60ft motor yacht cruising fast over turquoise Red Sea reef water, white wake

shaft.desc: Underwater view of yacht stern: twin inclined propeller shafts, bronze props, two rudders, trim tabs, sandy seabed

ips.desc: Underwater view of yacht stern with two Volvo IPS pod drives, forward-facing twin props, deep blue water, reef

marina.desc: Top-down aerial of white motor yacht entering a tight berth between yachts in a marina, turquoise water, white pontoons

engine.desc: Bright yacht engine room, marine engineer in navy uniform and black gloves servicing a white diesel engine, stainless exhaust pipes

ep002-cutaway.desc: Illustrated stern cut-away: engine room window, seacock under hull, strainer, raw-water pump, heat exchanger, wet exhaust spraying from transom, sea below

ep002-freshloop.desc: Blueprint schematic: engine block with closed coolant loop (hot red out, cooled gold back) to a heat exchanger; seawater tubes in/out on the right

ep002-impeller.desc: Blueprint close-up of a raw-water pump: housing with bolts, cam, black rubber impeller with 12 flexible blades, brass shaft

ep002-impeller-worn.desc: Same pump with a damaged impeller: 3 broken blade stubs circled in coral, cracks, loose blade fragments

ep002-cta.desc: Faint worn-impeller on blueprint grid - calm background for text-heavy scenes

ep003-roll.desc: Illustrated bow-on (front view) white motor yacht heeled ~13 deg on a swell, faint ghost rolled the other way, gold double-headed roll arc above, turquoise sea

ep003-gyro.desc: Blueprint bow-on hull cross-section with a gyro stabilizer: sealed sphere, gold flywheel with spin arrow, cradle; coral roll arrow vs turquoise counter-push arrow above

ep003-gyro-close.desc: Same gyro blueprint cross-section without the roll arrows (good for close zooms)

ep003-anchor.desc: Illustrated side-profile yacht at anchor on calm water, glowing gyro inside the hull, anchor chain to sandy seabed, clean hull bottom

ep003-fins.desc: Underwater bow-on view of a yacht hull with two fin stabilizers, left fin lifting (turquoise arrow up), right fin pushing down (coral arrow)

ep003-speed.desc: Illustrated side-profile yacht at speed, fin stabilizer visible under the hull, wake and speed lines astern

ep003-cta.desc: Faint rolling-yacht illustration on blueprint grid - calm background for text-heavy scenes
